hints.title: Primality Test Helper
hints.text: Check if an integer x is prime by testing factors up to its square root.

hints.title: Single Digit Deletions
hints.text: Convert the integer to a string and generate all numbers produced by omitting exactly one character.

hints.title: Validate All Reductions
hints.text: Verify that the original number is prime and that every single-digit omission produces a valid prime.

hints.title: Complete Implementation

complexity.notes: Here d is the number of digits of num.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Testing non-optimized prime divisibility up to num takes O(num) time instead of O(sqrt(num)).
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: String slicing takes O(d) auxiliary memory to inspect single digit deletions.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Expects clean O(sqrt(x)) primality checking and handling single-digit base cases.
